key_override.reason: The answers page (key image k0-40, p.145) is read correctly as "8.4 (d)", but (d) is physically impossible: halving the bulb power at fixed distance must reduce the field, never increase it, and √2E would require a 200 W bulb. With I = P/(4πr²) and I = ½cε₀E₀², E₀ ∝ √P, so E₅₀ = E·√(50/100) = E/√2, i.e. option (c); NCERT's own published solutions (Vedantu/Inspireup/Byjus) also give (c), so the printed answers-list cell is a typo. Transcription of stem and options verified against paper page 48 (all four options match).
